items.title: KREA 2 JUST GOT A MASSIVE DETAIL BOOST! INSANE RESULTS!
items.summary:
KREA 2 was already one of the most creative and visually impressive open image generation models available, but after pushing it even further, I found several new ways to get better prompt following, more details and even better-looking images while still running everything locally!

In this video, I showcase the new Krea2T Enhancer, my experimental Ideogram 4-style LoRA, and most importantly, my brand new COMBO workflow. This workflow takes your generated image and automatically passes it through a light second KREA 2 Turbo pass, preserving the original composition while adding even more details, textures and sharpness in only 4 extra steps.

I will show you how everything works, compare the normal workflow against the new enhanced and COMBO versions, and show you how to truly get the best results possible from KREA 2!

What do YOU think of these new KREA 2 improvements? Let me know in the comments below!👇
